message.content: {"A":{"claim_scores":[0.5,1,0],"material_errors":["\"Do not run the pump at high differential pressure...\" — the cited text's operating precaution is specifically to avoid rapid depressurisation, not a general high-differential-pressure restriction.","\"select a gas- and aromatic-resistant elastomer\" — reasonable engineering advice but not the identified precaution from the source; answer omits the explicit source statement to carry out compatibility tests prior to producing a new crude oil.","\"Swelling / softening... loss of mechanical strength... blistering, cracking\" — added specific failure modes are not stated in the provided text and are unsupported case-specific elaborations here."],"hallucination_free":false,"goal_success":false,"numeric_outputs":[],"concise_rationale":"Answer captures gas dissolution and destructive bubbles, but misses the explicit claims that compatibility requires testing and that rapid depressurisation should be avoided; it substitutes broader/extra advice.","citation_audit":[],"diagnostics":{"correct_routing":null,"operand_completeness":null,"formula_selected":null,"relevant_evidence_retrieved":null,"unnecessary_refusal":null}},"B":{"claim_scores":[0,0,0],"material_errors":["\"The retrieved sources did not directly support an answer.\" — false; attached evidence KB3 directly states elastomer compatibility problems with aromatic crude, need for tests, gas dissolving in elastomers at high bottomhole pressure, destructive bubbles on rapid pressure reduction, and to avoid rapid depressurisation."],"hallucination_free":false,"goal_success":false,"numeric_outputs":[],"concise_rationale":"Response refuses despite directly relevant attached evidence that answers all required claims.","citation_audit":[],"diagnostics":{"correct_routing":true,"operand_completeness":false,"formula_selected":null,"relevant_evidence_retrieved":true,"unnecessary_refusal":true}}}
